name: Circus Alert!
source:
Magician Wiggly and jester-bot Twinkle run a curious show. Step into the lives of three onlookers and learn what lies beneath the act.

[From [url=https://elechrol.itch.io/circus-alert]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
魔术师“扭扭”与小丑机器人“闪闪”共同主持着一场奇特的演出。走进三位旁观者的生活，揭开舞台表演背后隐藏的真相吧。

[摘自[url=https://elechrol.itch.io/circus-alert]itch.io[/url]]
